concept.hr: Energija titra između električnog polja u kondenzatoru i magnetskog u zavojnici
concept.en: Energy swings between the capacitor's electric and the coil's magnetic field

summary.hr: Nabijeni kondenzator prazni se kroz zavojnicu, a njezino magnetsko polje ga puni natrag obrnuto. Energija titra između dvaju polja frekvencijom f₀ = 1/(2π√LC).
summary.en: A charged capacitor discharges through the coil, whose magnetic field charges it back the other way. Energy swings between the two fields at f₀ = 1/(2π√LC).

what.hr: Aplet applet_schwingkreis.html (titranje titrajnog kruga u devet slika) i njegove slike 891–899 (krug s električnim i magnetskim poljem) i 1027–1035 (struja kroz vrijeme), te tekst o titrajnom krugu (50ohm.de, odjeljci schwingkreis_1 i oszillatoren, hrvatski prijevod)
what.en: The applet applet_schwingkreis.html (a resonant circuit oscillating, in nine pictures) and its figures 891–899 (the circuit with its electric and magnetic fields) and 1027–1035 (the current over time), and the text on the resonant circuit (50ohm.de, sections schwingkreis_1 and oszillatoren, Croatian translation)

credits.by: 50ohm.de-Autorenteam, AJW-Referat des DARC e.V. (figures: Prof. Dr. Matthias Jung, DL9MJ)

changes.hr: Prilagođen simdeck kitu, slike ponovno nacrtane kao SVG, preveden na engleski, petlja slika postala 9 koraka po osmini periode, dodani napon na kondenzatoru, raspodjela energije, izbor L i C s Thomsonovom formulom i predlošci
changes.en: Adapted to the simdeck kit, the figures redrawn as SVG, translated into English, the picture loop turned into 9 steps of one eighth of a period each, the capacitor voltage, the energy shares, a choice of L and C with Thomson's formula and presets added
